I’m Yutong Zhang, an undergraduate studying Financial Technology at Dongbei University of Finance and Economics 🎓. My research interests center on AI for Finance, particularly how large language models make sense of financial information and how we can make them more reliable for financial analysis and decision support.

My current work spans ESG text analysis, banking AI agents, and LLM evaluation and trustworthiness for financial applications. I study where models get the facts wrong and how their behavior changes over multi-turn conversations. I want to better understand their capabilities and limits, and what these mean for their use in finance. 🔍

Outside research, I’d love to be a wandering bard: travel the world 🎒, sing, play music and dance 🎶, make new friends 🤝, and venture into unfamiliar places 🗺️. And I have one very sincere wish: world peace 🕊️.
